remediation.caching_fix: Enforced manifest-first copying (COPY package.json package-lock.json* ./) prior to dependency installation (RUN npm ci / npm install), preserving Docker layer caching across source-only changes.
remediation.context_isolation: Enforced .dockerignore ensuring .env, .env.*, .git, test suites, and uncompiled files are excluded from image build context.
remediation.security_hardening: Maintained unprivileged execution via appuser:appgroup and active HEALTHCHECK probe targeting http://localhost:${PORT:-3000}/live.

verification_results.layer_order: CORRECT (package manifest -> npm install -> copy src -> build -> runner)
